name: Lord of the Pit
description: A demon summoned by Thomil that ate a man-thing and attacked Worzel, then turned on Thomil.

description_citations.text: "Worzel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Lord of the Pit eats the orc warlord, his sergeant and the serpent generator, and the mercenaries flee.
timeline.quote: the Lord of the Pit returns from battle just then and eats the warlord and his sergeant as his tribute.

citation.text: "The Monsters of Magic", section "Unlikely Allies and Unjust Desserts , by Brian M. Thomsen". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thomil summons a Lord of the Pit; Worzel finally finds a white leyline and casts Circle of Protection: Black, withstanding the demon.
timeline.quote: Finally, with a white leyline, Worzel cast a Circle of Protection: Black

citation.text: "Worzel", section "Gathering leylines on Ergamon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Lord of the Pit turns on Thomil, who flees the plane; Worzel planeswalks back to Cabralin with Roreca.
timeline.quote: He fled the plane, and his summoned demon vanished after raging around the plane for a time.

citation.text: "Worzel", section "Gathering leylines on Ergamon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: Thomil summoned a Lord of the Pit and a "man-thing" as a sacrifice to the demon
